item: A Stop that lands as a raw transport error on the collector's feed GET or article fetch is counted as a Stop, not a connect failure
summary: pipeline.py classified fetch failures from the error text alone, so a Stop on the last request (retries exhausted) arrived as a raw request error wrapping AirplaneModeError and was tallied as ff:connect / a feed failure. _failure_reason now reads the kill switch AFTER the failure (R320): HTTP statuses and robots disallows stay the host's answer, anything else under an engaged switch is offline. Stated cost: a genuine transport failure coinciding with a Stop reads offline. Six tests; three red before.
